Name: Slimmer Seasonal Cute Characters
Author: yhzx
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]I really like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - SCA [/url]mod, but after installing some other mods that add additional character sprites, I suddenly realized I actually prefer these female NPCs to be a bit more... uh... slim? So I used Photoshop to modify [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url]'s sprites by shrinking their legs inward by one pixel.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
God, this was way more work than I expected. The mod author of the SCA series is truly amazing.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
So far I've only done the leg-slimming for the four-season sprites and beach portraits of the 6 marriageable female characters. I haven't done the festival ones yet, though there are some exceptions.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
— Now Leah's summer sprite shows off her slim waist like in the vanilla version.
— Haley's summer back is slimmer.
— Additionally adjusted Penny's hands to make them thinner.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Special notes:
— Missing Abigail's winter outdoor sprite and fall sprite; have Abigail Eggf and iceF instead.
— Missing Penny's summer sprite; have Winter Star instead.
— Missing Maru's winter outdoor sprite.[/color]

[b][size=4]Future Plans:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][s]Vanilla sprites for some of the married women [/s] [b]Added slimmer sprites for Jodi, Robin, and Caroline.[/b] [/*]
[*][s]SVE sprites for the bachelorettes [/s][b]Added slimmer sprites for Clarie, Olivia, Sandy, Sophia, and Scarlett.[/b][/*]
[*]All festival sprites ( Maybe not today, maybe not tomorrow, maybe not next month, but one day, It will be done XD )[/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Unzip and replace.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url][/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Huge thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] for all the sprites. The amount of work behind this mod is truly amazing.[/color]
 Additional thanks to Ailin and Tanpoponoko for their contributions as well.
[color=#D4D4D8]And also, thank you to all the authors who worked on the SCA mod [/color]

Downloads.Description: Added slimmer sprites for the six marriageable female NPCs in vanilla Stardew Valley.
Added slimmer sprites for Jodi, Robin, and Caroline.
Added slimmer sprites for Clarie, Olivia, Sandy, Sophia, and Scarlett.
